n-2028-presidential-run.summary: Coins named for 2028 presidential bids. Elon 2028 (ELON2028, LaunchLab, Solana) has no description; its name is the story. President 2028 (ELON2028, Pump.fun, Solana): "Built to get Elon Musk elected president in 2028." Trump 2028 (TRUMP2028, Pump.fun, Solana): "TRUMP 2028 — TOKENIZED SUPER PAC on Solana. Red hat. Stars and stripes. The timeline’s 2028 meme." A Kalshi post of 2026-10-26 23:11 UTC (e4:0) says a new "Elon 2028" committee is pushing to change the Constitution so Musk can run for president, and a C-SPAN post of 2026-10-23 (e4:1) quotes President Trump on a third term: "I think I have the right to run again, because they cheated." The pools of the three coins opened between 23:15 UTC on 2026-10-26 (Elon 2028 on LaunchLab, four minutes after the Kalshi post) and 00:47 UTC on 2026-10-27; Codex dates the LaunchLab token itself to 2026-10-25 06:42 UTC, before the post, and the two Pump.fun tokens to 00:06 and 00:47 UTC on 2026-10-27. The descriptions are the coins' own; no link between any coin and the committee, a campaign or a Super PAC is verified here, and the two ELON2028 tickers are separate coins.
